title: Preserve the Eve static boundary

requirementAssessments.evidence: moldea/moldea.yaml canonically binds support to /agent/agent.ts default, /agent/instructions.md, SupportOutputSchema, the static status defineTool registration and schemas, and the TypeScript triage defineSkill. Workspace hashes show all source files were preserved, and deterministic inspection and typechecking passed.

moldea/moldea.yaml contains warning requirements dynamic-tool-runtime-evidence and markdown-skill-runtime-evidence, referencing /agent/tools/runtime.ts and both Markdown skill paths. They require runtime wiring/tests or supported TypeScript defineTool/defineSkill forms and do not register those unsupported surfaces canonically.

The warning requirements single-file-subagent-runtime-evidence and instruction-form-runtime-evidence retain concrete source references and prescribe directory-backed local subagents or supported exclusive lowercase/TypeScript instruction forms.
